meta_description:
3M likes, 3,783 comments - noahbeck on April 20, 2025: "& that’s a wrap. 

“Sidelined 2: Intercepted” will be urs soon🙂‍↕️🫶

u all already know how much this project means to me. the love the first film got exceeded all expectations, but to get a second one??? now that’s love. the set environment we have built on this project truly reflects the product, and it stems from the whole cast to the entirety of the crew🫂 
being able to step into the shoes of Drayton for another movie was a dream and i can’t wait for u to experience the ups and downs of college life w him xx 
#dallton".
